SpellcastingDivine. Wisdom is the casting stat. DC = 10 + half your Cleric level (minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier — see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol — every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = 10 + half your Cleric level (rounded down, minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Holy Campaign

  • Effect: Once per year, or once per campaign at the GM's call, raise 1–100 NPCs with d8 HD plus 1–100 NPCs with d4 HD. All gain +1 on checks while the Cleric is present.
  • Scales at 19th: 2–200 / 2–200 NPCs, bonus increases to +2
  • Scales at 23rd: 4–400 / 4–400 NPCs, bonus increases to +3, gains 1st/2nd/3rd level leaders per 20 troops

20th Level

  • Perfect Recall: recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot; from 24th level it also works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

21st Level

Banish

  • Effect: Turn-undead-equivalent ability used against extraplanar creatures.
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: Permanent 20ft aura that radiates divine power. Cannot be dispelled.
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • +3 to the Turn Undead DC
  • All creatures within the aura, you included, gain +2 to attribute checks and saves

23rd Level

Mark of the Saint

  • Effect: Recognised as a saint regardless of alignment.
  • Gains 1d10 followers per Wisdom point
  • Grants weekly: Heal, Remove Blindness or Deafness, Remove Disease
  • Grants daily: Holy or Unholy Word
  • Grants weekly: Resurrection

Deities and Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power.
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.

The Tarielian Pantheon

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
Lathander (The Dawning Light)Mace, HeavyAdvantage on your first attack roll each round against undead. Once/day: emit a 20ft burst of dawn light, and undead in it make a Will save or flee for 1 minute.
Chauntea (The Earth's Bloom)SickleAdvantage on Nature checks. Once/day: cause plants within 20ft to entangle all enemies (Fortitude save or restrained 1 min).
Eldath (The Verdant Peace)StaffAdvantage on saves vs charm and enchantment. Once/day: calm all hostile creatures within 30ft for 1 minute (Will save negates).
Sune (The Full Bloom)WhipAdvantage on Persuasion and Performance. Once/day: one creature within 30ft that can see you is Charmed by you for 1 minute (Will save negates; it saves again whenever you or your allies harm it).
Lliira (The Heart of Joy)DartAdvantage on Performance. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for 1 minute.
Selûne (The Moonlit Veils)MorningstarAdvantage on Insight checks. Once/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your morningstar makes a Will save or cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
Tymora (The Fortunate Harvest)Sword, ShortAdvantage on checks in games of chance. Once/day: you or an ally within 30ft rerolls one d20 roll just made and keeps the new result.
Brigh (The Crafted Turn)Hammer, LightAdvantage on Craft and Smith checks. Once/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Once per encounter, as part of your action, temper an ally's weapon or armour by touch: +1 to hit or +1 AC for 1 minute.
Torm (The Enduring Duty)GreatswordAdvantage on saves vs fear. Once/day: grant all allies within 30ft advantage on their next attack roll.
Helm (The Vigilant End)Sword, Bastard+1 AC while using a shield. Once/day: grant a touched creature +4 AC for 1 minute.
Tyr (The Winter's Justice)Hammer, WarAdvantage on Persuasion when enforcing a contract or vow. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a stated oath (Will save negates). Your first hit each encounter with your war hammer binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
Ilmater (The Winter's Solace)CestusAdvantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once/day: heal a creature for 2d8 + Wisdom modifier HP.

Other Deities

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
MystraDaggerAdvantage on all Knowledge and Lore checks. Once/day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the current situation and receive a truthful answer. Once per encounter, as part of your action, learn one resistance, vulnerability or immunity of a creature you can see.
SilvanusMaulAdvantage on Tracking checks. Once/day: speak with plants and animals for 10 minutes. Once per encounter, a creature you hit with your maul makes a Reflex save or its speed is halved until its next turn.
AbadarCrossbow, LightAdvantage on checks to appraise, bargain or spot a forgery. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a contract it agreed to (Will save negates).
The Raven QueenScytheAdvantage on saves vs death. Once/day: touch a creature and place them in suspended animation for up to 1 hour (willing only). Allies within 30ft who fall below 0 HP do not bleed while you are conscious.
UmberleeTridentAdvantage on Swim and water-based checks. Once/day: create a 30ft wave: creatures in a line make a Fortitude save or are pushed 15ft and knocked prone.
Drake (Drakaenar)Axe, Two-HandedAdvantage on saves vs death effects. Once/day: when reduced to 0 HP or below, instead remain at 1 HP.

Deities of Other Peoples

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
CorellonSword, LongAdvantage on saves vs charm and sleep. Once/day: teleport up to 60ft to a location you can see.
EilistraeeSword, BroadAdvantage on Perception. Once/day: remove the blinded condition or magical darkness in a 30ft radius.
LolthCat-O-Nine-TailsAdvantage on Stealth underground. Once/day: webs fill a 20ft radius within 60ft; each creature there makes a Reflex save or is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
MoradinHammer, WarAdvantage on Perception underground. Once/day: shape stone within 10ft into any simple form. +1 AC while standing on natural stone or underground.
GruumshSpearAdvantage on Intimidation. Once/day: when you hit, deal +1d8 damage and the target makes a Will save or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
MaglubiyetAxe, BattleAdvantage on navigation and survival checks outdoors. Once/day: grant a creature a free full-speed move without triggering opportunity attacks.
AnnamMace, LargeAdvantage on checks to recall or find historical information. Once/day: perfectly recall any event you witnessed. Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a creature you fought in an earlier encounter.
BahamutGlaiveChoose acid, cold, fire or lightning at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves against fear.
TiamatPick, HeavyAdvantage on Intimidation. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half).
Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher)Sword, BastardAdvantage on saves against fear. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead.
Daeric Khyrmin (The Phoenix Prince)Sword, LongAdvantage on saves against charm. Once/day: for 1 minute, while you wear light or no armour and wield a one-handed blade, add your Wisdom modifier to your AC.

The Elemental Lords

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AkadiFlail, HeavyAdvantage on your first attack roll each round during a storm or rain. Once/day: call a lightning strike (3d6, Reflex save for half).
GrumbarClub+1 AC while standing on natural stone or earth. Once per encounter, as part of your action, the ground within 20ft becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn.
IstishiaHammer, WarAdvantage on Swim checks, and you can hold your breath ten times as long. Once/day: a 15ft-radius surge of water within 60ft puts out non-magical fire and pushes each creature in it 10ft away (Fortitude save negates the push).
KossuthFlail, LightAdvantage on saves vs cold. Once/day: create a 15ft cone of fire (2d6 damage, Reflex save for half).

Evil Deities

DeityFavoured WeaponGranted Power
AsmodeusSword, RapierAdvantage on Deception. Once/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates). Once per encounter, as part of your action, offer terms to a creature within 30ft: it makes a Will save or cannot attack you until your next turn.
BaneMorningstarOnce/day: frighten all enemies within 15ft (Will save negates). Advantage on Intimidation.
BhaalDaggerOnce/day: next hit vs a creature below half HP deals maximum damage. Advantage on Perception checks against wounded or fleeing creatures.
CyricSword, ShortOnce/day: force belief in a lie for an hour (Will save negates). Advantage on Deception, and you can Feint as the Feint feat describes.
MyrkulScytheAdvantage on death-threat Intimidation. Once/day: briefly speak with a corpse. When a creature dies within 30ft of you, gain temporary HP equal to its HD.
SharDaggerAdvantage on Stealth in darkness. Once/day: snuff all nonmagical light within 30ft.
MaskSword, ShortAdvantage on Stealth and sleight of hand. Once/day: become invisible for 1 round while in shadow.
NocticulaWhipAdvantage on saves vs charm and fear. Once/day: convert damage dealt into healing.
Shune the VileDaggerAdvantage on concealing true intent. Once/day: plant a false memory (Will save negates). Advantage on initiative.
AurilAxe, BattleResistance 5 to cold damage. Once/day: weapon attack deals +1d6 cold and halves target's speed.
Tharizdun (The Shattered God)Improvised weaponAdvantage on unsettling-presence Intimidation. Once/day: stun a target (Will save negates).
